description: Baseline over 2027-2031 without the Milwaukee apartment adjustment (the parking addition does not change).

Baseline over 2027-2031 from a model trained on places with no parking reform nationwide, 0.97 times the same-pace baseline. In held-out tests no model beat same pace: on single cities same pace is as good as any, and on state totals the tree models only match same pace with a national level adjustment. Same pace ran 17-23% low in 2020-2025. The parking addition does not change.

Baseline over 2027-2031 if 2020-2025's strength continues: 132,391 (honest forest) to 134,270 (random forest), and up to 156,633 if every place keeps 2020-2025's full level over its earlier pace. In Wisconsin's own 2021-2025 back-test, same pace came in at 0.77 of actual, the forests at 0.95 and the full-level version at 1.01. The parking addition does not change (docs/parking/BASELINE_MODELS_RESULTS.md).
